title: Resolution urging Albany to help foster agencies afford insurance
summary: This resolution calls on the state Assembly to pass, and the Governor to sign, A.9646A to create an insurance risk pool helping foster care agencies obtain required liability insurance. It would also update state reimbursement rates to reflect rising insurance costs and create a voluntary foster care agency insurance bridge fund. Supporters say rising insurance costs threaten care continuity for more than 10,000 youth in foster care statewide.
